target_concept: sampling distribution of the sample mean
explicit_question: How does increasing the sample size affect the sampling distribution of the sample mean?
implicit_question: How does increasing the sample size affect the distribution of the averages obtained by repeatedly drawing samples of that size?
rationale: Conserva tamaño muestral y distribución de medias; la descripción operacional alarga la consulta.

target_concept: Type I and Type II errors
explicit_question: How do Type I and Type II errors differ in terms of the truth of the null hypothesis and the decision made?
implicit_question: In hypothesis testing, what are the two ways a decision about the null hypothesis can be wrong, considering whether that hypothesis is actually true or false?
rationale: Mantiene las dos decisiones erróneas sin proporcionar sus nombres.

explicit_question: What sequence of steps should be followed to conduct a hypothesis test?
implicit_question: What sequence of steps should be followed to assess a claim about a population using sample data and decide whether to reject it?
rationale: Puede confundir la afirmación de interés con la hipótesis nula; no incluir sin resolver esa equivalencia.

explicit_question: Why is the median a suitable measure of center when a dataset contains extreme outliers?
implicit_question: Why is the central value of an ordered dataset a suitable measure of center when the dataset contains extreme outliers?
rationale: La descripción proporciona parte de la explicación esperada y simplifica el caso de tamaño par.

explicit_question: What two aspects of the relationship between an independent and a dependent variable are summarized by the correlation coefficient?
implicit_question: What two aspects of the relationship between an independent and a dependent variable are summarized by a numerical measure of their association?
rationale: Una medida de asociación puede referirse a otras medidas; ocultar el nombre pierde unicidad.

explicit_question: If all other inputs remain unchanged, how does increasing the confidence level from 90% to 95% affect the width of the confidence interval, and why?
implicit_question: If all other inputs remain unchanged, how does increasing the confidence level from 90% to 95% affect the width of the range estimated from sample data for a population parameter, and why?
rationale: Se oculta confidence interval, no confidence level; explicitud relativa al concepto objetivo, no ausencia de todo tecnicismo.

explicit_question: For a standardized normal variable, what values define its center and spread, and how should the sign and magnitude of its standardized score be interpreted?
implicit_question: For a normally distributed variable expressed as distances from its mean in units of its standard deviation, what values define its center and spread, and how should the sign and magnitude of those distances be interpreted?
rationale: La descripción revela la interpretación que se pide; riesgo de filtración de respuesta.

explicit_question: With confidence level and population variability held constant, how does a larger sample affect the error bound and the width of a confidence interval?
implicit_question: With confidence level and population variability held constant, how does a larger sample affect the error bound and the width of the range estimated from sample data for a population parameter?
rationale: Conserva condiciones y ambos efectos solicitados; solo se oculta confidence interval.

explicit_question: Which distribution should be used to construct a confidence interval for a population mean when the population standard deviation is known versus when it is estimated by the sample standard deviation, and how do degrees of freedom enter the Student t case?
implicit_question: Which distribution should be used to construct a confidence interval for a population mean when the population standard deviation is known versus when it is estimated by the sample standard deviation, and how do degrees of freedom enter the latter case?
rationale: Retira la pista Student t; conserva ambas condiciones y la petición de grados de libertad.

explicit_question: What sequence should be followed to flag unusually low or high observations using the interquartile range of an ordered dataset?
implicit_question: What sequence should be followed to flag unusually low or high observations using the middle 50% of an ordered dataset?
rationale: Original implícita; alternativa explícita. No introducir el factor 1.5 en ninguna consulta.

explicit_question: How do the ordinary mean, a trimmed mean, and the median respond differently to extreme observations?
implicit_question: How do the average of all observations, an average computed after removing a proportion of observations from each end of the ordered data, and the central value of the ordered data respond differently to extreme observations?
rationale: La descripción revela mecanismos de robustez y modifica mucho la longitud; no forzar su inclusión.

explicit_question: How do discrete random variables associated with counting differ from continuous random variables associated with measurement in the kinds of numerical values they can take?
implicit_question: How do count-based outcomes differ from measurement-based outcomes in the kinds of numerical values they can take?
rationale: Original implícita; alternativa explícita conservando conteo y medición.

explicit_question: When is one-way ANOVA an appropriate choice, and how are its null and alternative hypotheses framed?
implicit_question: When is a test that compares population means across groups defined by a single factor an appropriate choice, and how are its null and alternative hypotheses framed?
rationale: La descripción aporta parte del criterio de uso; puede incluir alternativas a ANOVA. No incluir sin revisión.
